events.title: CHAI RAVE: Friendsgiving Bollywood Party, Orlando Edition
events.description: AV Entertainment is hosting a Bollywood party with chai at Cosmo Downtown. A Sulekha listing shows regular admission at $20 and $25 at the gate; confirm the current price on Eventbrite.
events.price: Regular admission listed at $20; $25 at the gate
